text: The graph shows the height above ground, in meters, of a ball x seconds after the ball was launched upward from a platform. Which statement is the best interpretation of the marked point (1.0, 3.9) in this context?

options.A: 1.0 second after being launched, the ball's height above ground is 3.9 meters.
options.B: 3.9 seconds after being launched, the ball's height above ground is 1.0 meter.
options.C: The ball was launched from an initial height of 1.0 meter with an initial velocity of 3.9 meters per second.
options.D: 1.0 second after being launched, the ball reached its maximum height of 3.9 meters.

text: In one week in 2017, a technician earned a total of $700 by working at her regular job and at a second job doing part-time work. The equation 16h + 13c = 700 represents this situation, where h is the number of hours worked at her regular job and c is the number of hours worked at her second job. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 16 in this context?

options.A: The amount, in dollars, the technician earned for each hour she worked at her regular job
options.B: The amount, in dollars, the technician earned for each hour she worked at her second job
options.C: The number of hours the technician worked in one week at her regular job
options.D: The number of hours the technician worked in one week at her second job
